tasks.analysis: European medieval history encompasses the period from the fall of the Roman Empire in the fifth century C.E. to the beginning of the Renaissance in the fifteenth century. This era saw significant developments, including the rise of feudalism as a social system, the establishment of powerful kingdoms, and the spread of Christianity throughout Europe.
